title: AI in the grocery store: How this CEO is changing shopping
title_zh: 杂货店中的人工智能：这位首席执行官如何改变购物方式
summary: Thrive Market CEO Nick Green explains how the company uses member data to simplify grocery shopping.
summary_zh: Thrive Market 首席执行官 Nick Green 解释了该公司如何使用会员数据来简化杂货购物。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures hit records as oil extends losses
title_zh: 油价扩大跌势，标普 500 指数和纳斯达克期货创历史新高
summary: May 7 (Reuters) - S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures hovered near all-time highs on Thursday as oil prices retreated further on hopes of a U.S.-Iran peace deal that could potentially normalize crude supplies
summary_zh: 路透 5 月 7 日 - 周四，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货徘徊在历史高位附近，因美国与伊朗达成和平协议可能使原油供应正常化的希望导致油价进一步回落

title: Amazon's Prime Video to invest at least 90 million euros in 2026 in local production, regulator says
title_zh: 监管机构称，亚马逊 Prime Video 到 2026 年将投资至少 9000 万欧元用于本地制作
summary: PARIS, May 7 (Reuters) - Amazon's Prime Video will invest at least 90 million euros ($105.95 million) in European video and movie production in French language this year, the French telecoms regulator
summary_zh: 路透巴黎 5 月 7 日 - 法国电信监管机构称，亚马逊 Prime Video 今年将投资至少 9000 万欧元（1.0595 亿美元）用于欧洲法语视频和电影制作

title: One of the S&P 500's best earnings seasons in 20 years comes with a catch: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数 20 年来最好的盈利季节之一也有一个陷阱：每日图表
summary: The S&P 500 is not just beating earnings expectations. It's blowing them up.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数不仅超出了盈利预期。它正在炸毁他们。

title: The stock market's semi-charmed life: Morning Brief
title_zh: 股市半迷人的生活：早间简报
summary: The stock market has soared to record highs in recent weeks, and one sector has been doing a lot of the work.
summary_zh: 最近几周股市飙升至历史新高，其中一个板块做了很多工作。

title: Quantum Motion raises $160 million to build quantum computers from standard silicon transistors
title_zh: Quantum Motion 融资 1.6 亿美元，用标准硅晶体管制造量子计算机
summary: Quantum Motion on Thursday said it raised $160 million to fund its effort to build a quantum computer that is ‌smaller, cheaper and more energy efficient than rivals using standard silicon chipmaking techniques.
summary_zh: Quantum Motion 周四表示，它筹集了 1.6 亿美元，用于资助其建造量子计算机的努力，该计算机比使用标准硅芯片制造技术的竞争对手更小、更便宜且更节能。

title: Humanoid Robots to Drive Next Leg of China Export Dominance
title_zh: 人形机器人将推动中国下一阶段的出口主导地位
summary: (Bloomberg) -- China’s early lead in humanoid robots will help power the next phase of its global manufacturing and export dominance, according to new research from Morgan Stanley.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——摩根士丹利的最新研究表明，中国在人形机器人领域的早期领先地位将有助于推动其下一阶段的全球制造和出口主导地位。

title: Morning Bid: No stopping AI frenzy in Asia
title_zh: 早盘竞价：亚洲的人工智能狂潮势不可挡
summary: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Ankur Banerjee Japan's Nikkei returned from holiday and jumped onto the scorching AI rally, joining South Korea and Taiwan equities at
summary_zh: 安库尔·班纳吉 (Ankur Banerjee) 对欧洲和全球市场未来一天的展望 日本日经指数结束假期归来，加入了炙手可热的人工智能涨势，加入了韩国和台湾股市的行列。

title: Kimi Chatbot Maker Moonshot AI Valued at $20 Billion in Meituan-Led Round
title_zh: Kimi 聊天机器人制造商 Moonshot AI 在美团领投的一轮融资中估值达 200 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Moonshot AI has raised about $2 billion in its latest funding round, signaling growing investor appetite for Chinese startups rivaling Silicon Valley’s leaders.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Moonshot AI 在最新一轮融资中筹集了约 20 亿美元，这表明投资者对与硅谷领先企业竞争的中国初创企业的兴趣日益浓厚。
